title: 36 Hours in Abu Dhabi
abstract: Once aloof from the spendthrift ways of neighboring Dubai, Abu Dhabi is now ticking off items on a five-star shopping list.

title: 36 Hours in Abu Dhabi
abstract: The capital of the United Arab Emirates, untouched by the region’s unrest, has been on a very high-end shopping spree.

title: 36 Hours in Amsterdam
abstract: Look beyond the city center for innovative shops, unusual art and casual cafes.

title: 36 Hours in Panama City, Panama
abstract: Central America’s capital of international finance, called by locals the “Dubai of the Americas,” is in the midst of a prolonged boomtown fever.

title: 36 Hours in Panama City, Panama
abstract: At the crossroads of two oceans and two continents, Panama City is a dynamic metropolis. That’s never been truer than it is today.

title: 36 Hours in Singapore
abstract: Singapore is booming, with new casinos, hotels, museums and, best of all, lounges and rooftop bars helping the city-state shake off its formerly staid image.
